annotations.title: Point at a bearing and distance

description: Where do you end up going a given distance on a given bearing from a start point? The end point on the WGS84 ellipsoid, in the formats you ask for. More APIs from FitzTopPicks: https://fitztoppicks.com/apis?utm_source=mcp-api&utm_medium=mcp&utm_campaign=more-apis

bearing.description: Initial bearing in degrees from true north (-360 to 360).

inputFormat.description: Skip auto-detection: latlon (dd/dms/ddm), utm, ups, mgrs, pluscode, geohash, maidenhead.

order.description: For letterless numbers: latlon (default) or lonlat. Hemisphere letters and lat/lon labels win.

ref.description: Reference point for short plus codes (in the input, and to add a short code to the output), like "40.4,-79.9".

to.description: Output formats for the end point (default dd,dms).

unit.description: m (default), km, mi, nmi or ft.

name: destination_point
title: Point at a bearing and distance
